info.name: Juniper Networks Junos Space Network Management Platform API

description.content:
Junos Space Network Management Platform provides a RESTful API for centralized management of Juniper devices. The API supports device discovery, configuration management, software image deployment, script management, and audit logging. Resources are accessed via the /api/space namespace with XML or JSON media types.
